analysis_declaration.family: 2 strict timings x 3 candidate-reference comparisons x 28 backgrounds x 4 overlapping seat/role slices

statistical_methods.exact_p: min(1, 2*sum_{j=0}^{min(improved,worsened)} choose(d,j)/2^d); exact Python integers/Fraction before float
statistical_methods.conservative_ci95: 97.5% Wilson intervals (z=2.2414027276) for improved and worsened probabilities, then [L_i-U_w,U_i-L_w]; approximate coverage, not exact
statistical_methods.clustered_ci95: deal_seed sandwich SE sqrt(G/(G-1)*sum_c(sum_i_in_c(d_i-mean))^2)/n; timing kept separate
statistical_methods.interaction: per game Y_NL-Y_N-Y_L+Y_0, range [-2,2]; not a binary McNemar test
statistical_methods.absolute_intervals: 95% Wilson per binary role/table outcome; no binomial CI on fractional mixed-side means

from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/Users/szh/Documents/SZH/Project/Agent Competition SAIR')
BG = 'first,random,heuristic,llm,llmx,llmq,mixed,rt_wolfpack,rt_talker,rt_detective,rt_chaos,guard_silent,guard_abstain,guard_fixed,guard_echo,guard_fake,guard_contradict,first_high_night,first_random_night,first_switch,pop_coordinated,pop_prompt_seer,pop_late_claim,pop_pressure_bus,pop_distance,pop_observed_switch,pop_survivor_kill,pop_anti_majority'
if __name__ == '__main__':
    for timing, visibility, games in [('rt','strict',500),('rounds','strict',500),('rt','legacy',200)]:
        out = ROOT/'logs/werewolf_benchmarks'/f'overnight-confirm-33101-33102-{timing}-{visibility}'
        cmd = [sys.executable,'-m','local.werewolf_research','--split','heldout','--profile','reference=agent',
               '--profile','night=local.werewolf_factorial_research:f16','--profile','listen=local.werewolf_factorial_research:f32',
               '--profile','combined=local.werewolf_factorial_research:f48','--games',str(games),'--backgrounds',BG,
               '--timing',timing,'--visibility',visibility,'--jobs','3','--trace-games','1','--out',str(out)]
        print('START',out.name,datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),flush=True)
        with out.with_suffix('.out').open('x') as stream:
            rc = subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
        print('DONE',out.name,rc,datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),flush=True)
        if rc: raise SystemExit(rc)
        d=json.loads((out/'summary.json').read_text())
        print({k:v['all']['seat'] for k,v in d['metrics'].items()},d['gates'],flush=True)
    out=ROOT/'logs/werewolf_benchmarks'/'overnight-confirm-33101-33102-k3-legacy'
    cmd=[sys.executable,'-m','local.werewolf_benchmark','--seed-registry','overnight','--split','heldout','--games','250',
         '--ks','3','--jobs','3','--candidate','local.werewolf_factorial_research:f48','--reference','agent',
         '--backgrounds',BG,'--timing','rt','--out',str(out)]
    print('START',out.name,datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),flush=True)
    with out.with_suffix('.out').open('x') as stream:
        rc=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
    print('DONE',out.name,rc,datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(rc)
